Class AIRequestGate

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.ai.AIRequestGate
@Service public class AIRequestGate extends Object
Every round trip to a language model passes this gate. In one JVM-wide critical section — the application runs one context per database — it deletes the log rows older than the retention, checks the daily budget of the user (DAY_CUD pseudo entity AIRequest) and the budget of the whole instance for the current UTC day, and reserves: a log row with status RESERVED is committed and the daily counter of the user is raised. A reservation counts whatever happens afterwards, including a failed call or a crash, because its billing state is unknown.

  • Method Details

    • reserve

      public Integer reserve(User user, AIRequestPurpose purpose, AIChatModelProvider.AIProviderChoice choice)
      Reserves one round trip, or refuses it when a limit is used up. The daily limit the tenant set for its key is checked first, so a key at its limit is skipped without counting against the daily budget of the user.
      Parameters:
      user - the user on whose behalf the model is called
      purpose - what the call is for
      choice - the provider, model and key source; for a tenant key also its row and daily limit
      Returns:
      the ID of the reservation, to be completed with complete(Integer, AIRequestStatus, Integer, Integer)
      Throws:
      AITenantLimitException - when the daily limit of the tenant key is reached
      DataViolationException - when the instance budget is used up or disabled
      LimitEntityTransactionException - when the daily budget of the user is used up

    • complete

      public void complete(Integer idAIRequestLog, AIRequestStatus status, Integer inputTokens, Integer outputTokens)
      Records the outcome of a reserved round trip; the reservation keeps counting either way.
      Parameters:

      inputTokens - reported input tokens, or null
      outputTokens - reported output tokens, or null
